glosses: land as defined by its geographical (and architectural) features
scenery, land as viewed from a given vantage point
a picture, especially a painting, of such a view

examples.text: Wir bewunderten die Schönheit der Landschaft.
examples.en: We admired the beauty of the scenery.
The scenery was beautiful beyond description.

examples.text: Die Landschaft ist sehr schön in dieser Gegend.
examples.en: The scenery around here is very beautiful.
